programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.desc: Stan puts his Bowtech to use as the whitetail rut heats up in his home state. Dr. James Kroll explains the science behind mature buck travel patterns during the breeding season. programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.desc: On this episode of North American Whitetail, Editor-in-Chief Haynes Shelton and Associate editor Blake Garlock kick off the season by crossing the border to Canada pursuing big deer in Alberta. Big Buck Profile heads to the Iowa Deer Classic where Haynes spends time looking at the Mike Weatherly buck!
